اعتكفت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَكَفْتُ (iʕtakaftu) /iʕ.ta.kaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# اِعْتَكَفْتَ (iʕtakafta) /iʕ.ta.kaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# اِعْتَكَفْتِ (iʕtakafti) /iʕ.ta.kaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# اِعْتَكَفَتْ (iʕtakafat) /iʕ.ta.ka.fat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
